lines.en: I know the roads of the otherworld well

lines.zh: 我扛着大块头的身子慢慢走
lines.en: I walk slowly, carrying this bulk

lines.zh: 每一步都沉，像带着一袋石头
lines.en: Each step is heavy, like hauling a sack of stones

lines.zh: 这条道通向哪儿，我懒得问
lines.en: Where this road leads, I cannot be bothered to ask
My hands are too big, I swing them wide when walking

lines.zh: 我走着，脚下腾起一点灰
lines.en: I walk and a little dust rises
The wind here is hot
I shuffle along, shoulders rolling
The path is too narrow, I have to go sideways

lines.zh: 走得慢，可我一步顶两步
lines.en: I walk slow, but one of my steps covers two
I hum a tune from the otherworld
Something moves ahead, I look first
I stand and my belly meets the wind first
The calluses on my hands are harder than stone
There is not much worth guarding here

lines.zh: 我揉了揉脖子，那里发酸
lines.en: I rub my neck, it aches
My breath comes out hot
I count the fires in the distance
My soles are planted, quite steady
Wait long enough and my stomach starts to growl

lines.zh: 在他们眼里，我算高大的
lines.en: To them I count as big
I plant my hands on my hips
The light comes through the fog of the otherworld
I look up, the sky is grey
I am thinking about that bowl of noodles again
Standing long, my toes go numb

lines.zh: 你这身子骨，在我眼里很小
lines.en: In my eyes your frame is very small

lines.zh: 我低头，肚子挡了一部分视线
lines.en: I look down, my belly blocks some of the view
How did a person get here

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，你身上的味儿新鲜
lines.en: I sniff, your scent is fresh
Do not stand at my feet
One hand could lift you
I have not seen clothes like yours
I blink, my eyes are small

lines.zh: 这么单薄，我捏一下就断
lines.en: So thin, one squeeze and you snap

lines.zh: 我歪着头看你，看得脖子都酸了
lines.en: I tilt my head at you until my neck aches
Why are you shaking, I have not moved
Do you know the rules here
I look at you like a meal

lines.zh: 我往后退了半步，给你留点地方
lines.en: I step back half a pace to leave you room
Where are your eyes hiding

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指了指你，又放下
lines.en: I lift a hand, point at you, then drop it
How long will you stand, I am waiting
It hurts, thick hide or not
That landed on bone
I grunt and give half a step
You dared hit me, I will not forget
The wound is shallow, the blood is hot
I rub it and it hurts more
A wound like this will not stop me
I look down at it, then lift my head
Strong for someone so small
I grit my teeth, they are hard

lines.zh: 你手里那口吃的，够谁吃
lines.en: That bite in your hand, who is that for

lines.zh: 我低头凑近，热气喷到你身上
lines.en: I lean down and hot breath washes over you
One bowl will not fill one spoon of mine

lines.zh: 吃的是好东西，可也太小了
lines.en: Food is good, but this is far too small
I will not snatch, you should offer
I caught the smell of meat
You hold it up and your arm is trembling

lines.zh: 我张嘴，你先看看有多大
lines.en: I open my mouth, look how big it is first

lines.zh: 这点东西塞牙缝都不够
lines.en: This will not even fill a gap in my teeth
Put it on the ground, bending down is hard for me

lines.zh: 撞我？我的肚子是软的，骨头是硬的
lines.en: Bumping me? My belly is soft, my bones are not

lines.zh: 你被弹出去，我还在原地
lines.en: You are knocked back and I have not moved
Do not come at my back, I am not used to it

lines.zh: 我侧了侧身，让过你一半
lines.en: I turn sideways and let you pass halfway

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚背上，会觉得像石头
lines.en: Step on my foot and it feels like stone

lines.zh: 这一下，我听见你的骨响
lines.en: That one, I heard your bone
I put a hand out to stop you
No rush, the road is wide enough

lines.zh: 你撞上来的时候，我晃都没晃
lines.en: You bumped into me and I did not even sway
Crowd me again and I will hoist you up

lines.zh: 我这样的大块头，找伴不容易
lines.en: A big one like me does not find company easily

lines.zh: 冥界的鬼也想要个伴，靠过来些。
lines.en: Even an underworld ogre wants company. Come closer.
There is little ceremony in the otherworld

lines.zh: 我低头看你，你看我，就够了
lines.en: I look down, you look up, that is enough

lines.zh: 我不太会说话，话说重了别怪
lines.en: I am not good with words, forgive the bluntness
My belly is big, hugging is not easy
People here are afraid of me
Go if you want, I will not hold you

lines.zh: 我拍了拍胸口，声音很闷
lines.en: I thump my chest, it sounds dull

lines.zh: 拉着我的手，别说那些有的没的
lines.en: Take my hand and skip the chatter
I have to bend down slowly
My fingers are too thick, several tries

lines.zh: 这东西拿在手里像颗豆
lines.en: In my hand it feels like a bean
I hold it up to the light

lines.zh: 掉地上就脏了，我拍拍它
lines.en: It fell and got dirty, I dust it off
Everything in the otherworld is heavy
I stuff it into my clothes

lines.zh: 这玩意儿闻着不像吃的
lines.en: This does not smell like food
Picking it up is nothing, it is easy
I cup it, afraid of crushing it
These eyes are fixed on you now

lines.zh: 我抬起拳头，比你的头还大
lines.en: I raise a fist bigger than your head

lines.zh: 这里归我看守，闯进来的都得留
lines.en: This is my post, intruders stay
Where did you pop out from
I have your ki memorized
I inhale and my belly swells

lines.zh: 想跑就跑吧，跑得再快也没用
lines.en: Run if you like, speed will not help

lines.zh: 我这身板，一次能撞倒三个
lines.en: This frame of mine can bowl over three at once
Stand still and let me see you clearly
The living are not welcome here
I stamp out a dull boom
Do not hide behind the pillar
I spread my hands and block the road
Either back off or lie down
I have already decided
I chase slowly, but I do not detour

lines.zh: 你走到哪儿，我就跟到哪儿
lines.en: Wherever you go, I follow

lines.zh: 窗户太小，我进不去，就砸墙
lines.en: The window is too small, so I break the wall

lines.zh: 我一步步踩过去，地面在响
lines.en: I stomp step by step, the ground rings

lines.zh: 你不用回头，我就在后面
lines.en: No need to look back, I am behind you

lines.zh: 这一片我熟，拐角都清楚
lines.en: I know this area, every corner

lines.zh: 我抓起一块石头，掂了掂
lines.en: I pick up a stone and weigh it
Your breathing is quickening
I do not shout, shouting wastes strength
Keep running that way and it is a dead end
I stand in the doorway and you have no way

lines.zh: 你的脚步声我一次都没漏
lines.en: I have not missed a single one of your steps

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把袖子卷起来
lines.en: I roll up my sleeve as I walk
A narrow corridor suits me fine

lines.zh: 我站在路中央，你只能绕
lines.en: I stand in the middle of the road, you must go around

lines.zh: 你把门关上了，我就拆门
lines.en: You shut the door, so I take the door apart

lines.zh: 地上那串脚印，一步顶两步
lines.en: Those prints of yours, each of mine covers two

lines.zh: 我抬手挡住光，看见你了
lines.en: I shade my eyes and there you are
One punch and the floor tiles shatter

lines.zh: 我抓住你的腰，往墙上一按
lines.en: I grab your waist and press you to the wall
My palm lands flat on your back

lines.zh: 这一膝盖，够你躺一会儿
lines.en: That knee will put you down a while

lines.zh: 我撞过去，你连人带甲都飞
lines.en: I charge and you and your armor go flying
I held back, afraid of killing you

lines.zh: 我抡起胳膊，风先到你脸上
lines.en: My arm swings and the wind reaches you first

lines.zh: 你挡得挺像样，可力气不够
lines.en: You blocked well, but you lack strength
I bring my foot down, you had better roll
This one drives you into the ground
I hoist you up and throw
You are still standing, I am surprised
I fill the doorway, you cannot get out
The second blow is heavier than the first

lines.zh: 我往前挤，你的空间就没了
lines.en: I push forward and your space is gone
Held, so stop squirming

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，先看见肚子
lines.en: I emerge from the fog, belly first
A shape has joined this side of the otherworld

lines.zh: 我落地时，地面低了一寸
lines.en: When I land, the ground sinks an inch
I slap the dust off my shoulders

lines.zh: 热气散开，我就站在那儿
lines.en: The heat clears and I am standing there
I lift a foot and kick a stone aside

lines.zh: 这么大的个子，没法不显眼
lines.en: Something this big cannot be inconspicuous

lines.zh: 我停在路口，看了看两边
lines.en: I stop at the fork and look both ways
It is empty here, a good place to rest
I am here, do not panic
I open my mouth to pant, it is loud
The grass by my feet curls from the heat
I tug the rope at my waist
The otherworld light falls on me

lines.zh: 我一出现，那几只小东西就散了
lines.en: The moment I appear, the small ones scatter

lines.zh: 我站直了，头顶快到门梁
lines.en: I straighten up, my head near the door beam
I walk over and the road seems narrower
Fire on my hide and it shines with grease

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候，我一个人砸出个坑
lines.en: Falling, I made a crater on my own
The water is cold and my body is heavy
The blast rocked me twice
A small arrow is stuck in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股劲儿钻进身子里，头发麻
lines.en: That force got inside me and my hands went numb

lines.zh: 饿得肚子贴背，这滋味难熬
lines.en: Hungry enough to feel hollow, a hard thing

lines.zh: 雷下来，我半个身子都是麻的
lines.en: Lightning fell and half of me is numb

lines.zh: 脚下没底，我这样的个子最怕这个
lines.en: No footing, and my size fears nothing more
